annotations.title: Search the Georgia Code or a constitution

description: Full-text search of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated (or, with `scheme`, of the Georgia or United States constitution): words, or a citation, or both. A citation among words returns that section first; a query that names an act returns the section stating its short title first; a query that is a passage of a provision word for word returns that provision first. Search matches the words of the document: ask in the words the statute would use. `in_headings` searches only headings and catchlines and adds the matching units. `scheme`: `ocga` (default), `ga` for the Georgia constitution, `us` for the United States constitution.

chapter.description: Only sections in this chapter of `title` (5, 11A).
chapter.title: Chapter

in_headings.description: Search only titles and headings instead of the full text.
in_headings.title: In Headings

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 40 (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: The words to search for, in the words the document itself would use.
query.title: Query

scheme.description: Which text to search: ocga (the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, the default), ga (the Constitution of the State of Georgia), or us (the Constitution of the United States).
scheme.title: Scheme

title.description: Only sections in this title of the Code (1 to 53).
title.title: Title

name: code_search
title: Search the Georgia Code or a constitution
